dimensions.title: Learning Objectives
dimensions.description: Lessons must contain measurable learning objectives with action verbs.
dimensions.failingMessage: One or more lessons are missing learning objectives.
dimensions.promptGuidance: Use measurable objectives that start with an action verb (e.g. explain, calculate, compare, construct). NEVER use 'understand', 'know', or 'learn'.

dimensions.title: Assessment & Practice
dimensions.description: Course lessons must include check-for-understanding quizzes or practice activities.
dimensions.failingMessage: Add a quiz or practice activity so learners can check understanding.
dimensions.promptGuidance: Include exactly one quiz activity per lesson with multiple-choice questions (4 options each, exactly 1 correct option).

dimensions.title: Course Duration & Scope
dimensions.description: Courses should maintain a focused scope with 1 to 6 lessons.
dimensions.failingMessage: Outline should have between 1 and 6 lessons/activities for a focused course.
dimensions.promptGuidance: 1 to 6 lessons only (teachers build short, focused courses).

dimensions.title: Course Completeness
dimensions.description: Course spec must be complete with no compilation errors and required metadata.
dimensions.failingMessage: Outline is empty or compilation reported errors.
dimensions.promptGuidance: All required fields in the course spec contract must be present and non-empty.
